title: REQ · AdminApp passes approve, retry and reject handlers that call the client and reload
summary: A single runExecutionAction helper drives onApprove, onRetry and onReject.
description: AdminApp imports approveExecution, rejectExecution, retryExecution, adds runExecutionAction(action, id) that calls the client with the token and then increments reloads, and passes the three handlers to ExecutionPanel.
acceptance_criteria: Given the panel shows Approve, when clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve is called with Bearer token and executions are refetched
Given Retry or Reject is clicked, then the retry or reject endpoint is POSTed and the data is refetched
